reason: A local-first Markdown wiki that preserves source evidence, maintains linked synthesized pages, provides lexical search, and gives an agent durable knowledge context.

summaries.zh: 一个本地优先的证据关联 Markdown 知识库插件，用于保存不可变来源、维护引用来源的页面并提供确定性搜索。
summaries.en: A local-first evidence-linked Markdown wiki plugin for preserving immutable sources, maintaining cited pages, and providing deterministic search.

capabilities: reads and writes wiki files on the local filesystem
stores immutable source records with content hashes
creates and updates evidence-linked Markdown pages
runs read-only validation and index maintenance commands
